Java roadmap for beginners

Start small, build a solid foundation, and connect your learning to a project.

Editorial draft for review. Prepared for the JavaWallah learning resource library.

Start with one working program

Install the JDK and choose an IDE. Write a small program, compile it and change it. Learn to read an error message before adding more tools.

Learn the building blocks

Practise variables, conditions, loops, arrays and strings with small exercises. Explain the input, the steps and the expected output before you write code.

Think in objects, then build

Model a library or task list with classes and objects. Add collections, exception handling and persistence as the project grows.

Take it to the web

Move to SQL, JDBC and Spring Boot after the foundations feel familiar. Build a small REST API, document it and demonstrate how it works.

Put your learning into practice.
